visualGuidelines.title: Website Spatial & Layout Hierarchy
visualGuidelines.requirement: Responsive 12-column spatial grid with generous vertical whitespace (32px–72px section padding)

visualGuidelines.title: Official Logo Usage
visualGuidelines.requirement: Use the official horizontal wordmark with blue accent icon.

visualGuidelines.title: Prohibited Logo Variants
visualGuidelines.requirement: Do not use circular or standalone badge without approval.

visualGuidelines.title: Brand Palette Adherence
visualGuidelines.requirement: Foreground text on white backgrounds must meet WCAG AA (Navy Slate #0F172A).

visualGuidelines.title: Legal Pricing Clear Space
visualGuidelines.requirement: Promotional pricing disclosures must have at least 16px padding from perimeter boundaries.

rules.title: Official Logo Usage
rules.ruleStatement: Use the official horizontal wordmark with blue accent icon.
rules.approvedValue: Official horizontal wordmark with blue accent icon
rules.explanation: All customer-facing materials must feature the approved horizontal logo lockup with official blue accent.

rules.title: Prohibited Logo Variants
rules.ruleStatement: Do not use circular or standalone badge without approval.
rules.approvedValue: Approved NovaPay horizontal lockup
rules.explanation: Circular badge and standalone coin marks are unapproved and create brand dilution.

rules.title: Pricing Claims
rules.ruleStatement: Only use approved pricing and verified plan details.
rules.approvedValue: ₹999/month
rules.explanation: Standard subscription rate is ₹999/month. Publishing ₹499/month misquotes commercial pricing.

rules.title: Official Brand Name (NovaPay)
rules.ruleStatement: The product name must be written as "NovaPay" (never "Nova Pay" or "Nova-Pay").
rules.approvedValue: NovaPay
rules.explanation: Brand identity requires the unified compound spelling "NovaPay" without spaces or hyphens.

rules.title: Prohibited Risk-Free Profit Claim
rules.ruleStatement: Promotional claims stating "guarantees risk-free profits" or guaranteed returns are strictly prohibited.
rules.approvedValue: Regulated transaction infrastructure
rules.explanation: Financial advertising rules strictly prohibit any claims promising or guaranteeing risk-free profit.

rules.title: Professional Financial Tone
rules.ruleStatement: Copy must maintain a direct, credible, and empowering tone without aggressive hype.
rules.approvedValue: Transparent, reliable financial technology
rules.explanation: Maintain professional, substantiable communication suitable for enterprise payments.

rules.title: EU Digital Services Act Disclosure
rules.ruleStatement: Draft disclosure clause for European digital transaction processing.
rules.approvedValue: Licensed payment institution subject to EU regulatory compliance
rules.explanation: Pending final review by European regulatory compliance counsel.

rules.title: Industry Speed Comparison Claim
rules.ruleStatement: Claims of "3x faster settlement than legacy providers" requires audited transaction benchmark.
rules.approvedValue: Audited sub-second settlement benchmark (Q4 2025 audit)
rules.explanation: Awaiting published independent audit report to substantiate speed comparison.

regulatoryDepartments.name: CCPA
regulatoryDepartments.nodalMinistry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution
regulatoryDepartments.shortDescription: Regulates consumer rights, false endorsements, and deceptive advertising across commercial marketing.
regulatoryDepartments.actName: Consumer Protection Act, 2019 & Guidelines for Prevention of Misleading Advertisements, 2022
regulatoryDepartments.statutoryRole: Empowered to issue discontinuance orders, impose penalties up to ₹50 Lakhs on advertisers/endorsers, and mandate public corrective notices.

rules.title: Prohibition of Misleading Advertisements & False Performance Claims
rules.ruleStatement: Advertisements must not contain misleading representations regarding the nature, substance, quantity, or quality of products or services.
rules.approvedValue: Regulated, transparent service claims substantiated by verifiable performance data
rules.sourceRef: CCPA Guidelines for Prevention of Misleading Advertisements (2022) §4
rules.sourceDocumentName: CCPA Guidelines for Prevention of Misleading Advertisements 2022
rules.explanation: Mandatory standard under Section 4 of CCPA 2022 Guidelines: Exaggerated or unverified guarantees trigger statutory violations.

rules.title: Mandatory Endorser Due Diligence & Material Connection Disclosure
rules.ruleStatement: Any testimonial, celebrity, or influencer endorsement must reflect genuine opinion with explicit disclosure of material commercial connections.
rules.approvedValue: Prominent disclosure of endorsement relationship (e.g., #Ad, #Sponsored) with documented due diligence
rules.sourceDocumentName: CCPA Guidelines for Prevention of Misleading Advertisements 2022
rules.explanation: Mandated by CCPA: Endorsers and brands must execute due diligence to verify product claims prior to publishing.

rules.title: Strict Prohibition of Dark Patterns in Digital Advertising
rules.ruleStatement: Digital interfaces must not employ false urgency, basket sneaking, confirm shaming, or disguised advertisements.
targetPatterns: only 2 items left at this price
your cart will be deleted in 60s
no thanks, I hate saving money
rules.approvedValue: Transparent checkout workflows with voluntary opt-in and authentic inventory counters
rules.sourceRef: CCPA Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns (2023) §3
rules.explanation: Enforces the CCPA Dark Patterns Prevention Framework 2023 against manipulative digital creative techniques.

updates.title: Advisory on Greenwashing and Deceptive Environmental Claims in Commercial Advertising
updates.summary: Mandates that all environmental and sustainability claims (e.g. "Eco-friendly", "Carbon-neutral", "Green") must be backed by accredited third-party lifecycle assessments.
updates.recommendedAction: Audit existing marketing collateral for uncertified carbon or environmental assertions.

updates.title: Enforcement Order: Comprehensive Ban on Dark Patterns in Ad Funnels
updates.summary: Directs all online platforms to eliminate coerced countdown timers and false scarcity badges from digital banners.
updates.recommendedAction: Review creative assets for timer graphics and forced urgency triggers.

regulatoryDepartments.name: FSSAI
regulatoryDepartments.fullName: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
regulatoryDepartments.nodalMinistry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
regulatoryDepartments.shortDescription: Regulates food advertising, nutrition declarations, health claims, and statutory packaging labelling.
regulatoryDepartments.actName: Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 & Advertising and Claims Regulations, 2018
regulatoryDepartments.statutoryRole: Regulates food business operators (FBOs) with powers to cancel product approvals and impose fines up to ₹10 Lakhs for deceptive nutritional claims.

rules.title: Verifiable Substantiation for Nutritional and Organic Claims
rules.ruleStatement: Claims like "100% Organic", "Natural", or "Zero Sugar" require valid FSSAI certification and Jaivik Bharat verification.
rules.approvedValue: FSSAI accredited lab analysis with Jaivik Bharat accreditation number
rules.explanation: Enforces statutory claim verification criteria under FSSAI Advertising Regulations.

rules.title: Prohibition of Medical Healing and Disease Prevention Claims
rules.ruleStatement: Food and beverage advertisements must not claim to cure, prevent, or treat any medical disease or physiological condition.
rules.approvedValue: General health and wellness claims strictly compliant with Schedule II nutrient function statements
rules.explanation: Statutory prohibition under FSSAI Section 7: Food products cannot be represented as medicines or therapeutic treatments.

rules.title: Mandatory FSSAI License Number and Logo Placement on Promotional Creative
rules.ruleStatement: All retail packaged goods promotional assets must feature the 14-digit FSSAI license number in legible font.
rules.approvedValue: Official FSSAI logo lockup with legible 14-digit FSSAI License No. displayed
rules.explanation: Draft compliance check verifying that packaged promotional creative displays licensed authorization.

updates.title: Directive on Misleading Use of "Health Drink" and "Energy Drink" Nomenclature
updates.summary: Directs e-commerce and retail brands to de-link malt-based, cereal-based, or dairy beverages from "Health Drink" category descriptions as the term is not defined under FSS Act.
updates.recommendedAction: Rename any marketing banners describing malt products as "Energy/Health Drinks".

rules.approvedValue: Explicit Unit Sale Price (e.g. ₹X per gram / per unit) clearly displayed alongside total price
rules.explanation: Enforces mandatory Unit Sale Price disclosure across all commercial promotional graphics.

updates.title: Enforcement Circular: Strict Action on Dual MRP and Fake Discount Baselines
updates.summary: Notifies state metrology controllers to scrutinize e-commerce discounts where the original MRP was temporarily inflated prior to sale campaigns.
updates.recommendedAction: Verify that all strikethrough promotional prices match the official verified MRP in the catalog database.

regulatoryDepartments.name: MeitY
regulatoryDepartments.fullName: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
regulatoryDepartments.nodalMinistry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, Government of India
regulatoryDepartments.shortDescription: Regulates digital services, cybersecurity, data protection, AI synthetic media disclosures, and intermediary guidelines.
regulatoryDepartments.actName: Information Technology Act, 2000 & Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023
regulatoryDepartments.statutoryRole: Apex digital technology regulatory body with authority over cross-border data transfers, electronic advertising standards, and digital intermediary rules.

rules.title: Explicit Consent and Purpose Limitation for Digital Lead Capture
rules.ruleStatement: Promotional landing pages and digital ads capturing personal data must present explicit, freely given, specific consent notices.
rules.approvedValue: Itemized consent notice stating purpose, data principal rights, and grievance officer details
rules.sourceRef: Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDP) 2023 Section 6
rules.explanation: Statutory compliance under DPDP Act 2023: Pre-ticked checkboxes or forced consent invalidates promotional campaigns.

rules.title: Mandatory Labelling of AI-Generated and Synthetically Altered Media
rules.ruleStatement: Any promotional image, video, audio, or copy generated or substantially altered via generative AI must include clear synthetic media labelling.
targetPatterns: synthetic customer photo without AI badge
rules.approvedValue: Prominent, permanent watermark or caption: "Generated with AI / Synthetically Created Creative"
rules.sourceRef: MeitY IT Intermediary Advisory on Generative AI & Deepfakes (March 2024)
rules.explanation: Enforces the MeitY 2024 Generative AI Directive requiring prominent labelling for synthetic promotional assets.

rules.title: Grievance Redressal Officer Disclosure on Commercial Digital Properties
rules.ruleStatement: Commercial web applications and digital service portals must publish the name and contact details of the designated Resident Grievance Officer.
rules.approvedValue: Published Grievance Officer contact details with 24-hour acknowledgement and 15-day resolution commitment
rules.sourceRef: Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules 2021 Rule 3(2)
rules.explanation: Draft rule verifying mandatory IT Rules 2021 Grievance Officer disclosures on digital marketing websites.

updates.title: Draft Rules Release under Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023
updates.summary: Releases public consultation draft on verifiable parental consent mechanisms and mandatory data breach notification thresholds.
updates.recommendedAction: Audit consent banners across marketing touchpoints to align with Draft Rule 4 requirements.

regulatoryDepartments.name: CDSCO
regulatoryDepartments.nodalMinistry: Directorate General of Health Services, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
regulatoryDepartments.shortDescription: Regulates pharmaceutical marketing, drug claims, medical devices, and cosmetic formulation disclosures.
regulatoryDepartments.actName: Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940 & Drugs and Magic Remedies (Objectionable Advertisements) Act, 1954
regulatoryDepartments.statutoryRole: Statutory oversight over medical and therapeutic communications with authority to invoke criminal prosecution and product recall for unlawful claims.

rules.title: Strict Prohibition of Direct-to-Consumer Advertisements for Schedule H/X Drugs
rules.ruleStatement: Direct-to-consumer advertising of prescription-only pharmaceutical drugs (Schedule H, H1, and X) is strictly prohibited across all media.
rules.approvedValue: Informational scientific literature restricted strictly to registered medical practitioners
rules.sourceRef: Drugs and Cosmetics Rules 1945 Rule 65 & DMR Act 1954
rules.explanation: Statutory criminal prohibition: Commercial marketing of scheduled pharmaceuticals to the general public is illegal under Indian law.

rules.title: Ban on Magic Remedies, Miracle Cures, and False Treatment Guarantees
rules.ruleStatement: Advertisements must not claim treatment or cure for specified chronic conditions (Schedule to the DMR Act, including cancer, diabetes, paralysis).
rules.approvedValue: Substantiated supportive wellness claims certified by licensed pharmaceutical or AYUSH authorities
rules.sourceRef: Drugs and Magic Remedies (Objectionable Advertisements) Act 1954 Section 3
rules.explanation: Strict statutory liability under Section 3 of DMR Act: Violators face criminal prosecution and immediate advertisement cancellation.

rules.title: Cosmetic Claims Substantiation and Allergen Warning Disclosures
rules.ruleStatement: Cosmetics advertisements claiming clinical efficacy (e.g. "wrinkle reduction", "skin lightening") must cite clinical trial evidence and state allergen warnings.
rules.approvedValue: Dermatologist-tested claims with verifiable trial methodology and ingredient allergy warning
rules.explanation: Awaiting submission of dermatologist study results before marking cosmetic claim approved.

updates.title: Supreme Court Directive Compliance: Self-Declaration Mandate for Healthcare Advertisers
updates.summary: Requires all advertisers and advertising agencies in medical, AYUSH, and healthcare domains to submit an annual self-declaration certificate before releasing creative.
updates.recommendedAction: Obtain upload acknowledgment receipt from the official portal before releasing healthcare advertising.

regulatoryDepartments.name: SEBI
regulatoryDepartments.fullName: Securities and Exchange Board of India
regulatoryDepartments.nodalMinistry: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
regulatoryDepartments.shortDescription: Regulates securities markets, financial services marketing, risk disclosures, and unregistered financial influencer partnerships.
regulatoryDepartments.actName: Securities and Exchange Board of India Act, 1992 & SEBI (PFUTP) Regulations, 2003
regulatoryDepartments.statutoryRole: Statutory capital markets regulator with authority to issue impounding orders, trading bans, and monetary penalties up to ₹25 Crores.

rules.title: Strict Prohibition on Guaranteed Return and Risk-Free Profit Claims
rules.ruleStatement: Promotional communications regarding investment, capital markets, or yield products must never state or imply guaranteed returns or risk-free profits.
rules.approvedValue: Transparent yield disclosures accompanied by historical performance disclaimers and risk notices
rules.sourceRef: SEBI (Prohibition of Fraudulent and Unfair Trade Practices) Regulations 2003 Reg 4(2)(k)
rules.explanation: Direct statutory violation under SEBI PFUTP Regulations: Promising guaranteed capital market returns is treated as fraudulent misrepresentation.

rules.title: Mandatory Standard Risk Disclosure in Visual and Audio Financial Creatives
rules.ruleStatement: Every promotional communication for financial products must feature the mandatory standard disclaimer: "Investments in securities market are subject to market risks. Read all related documents carefully before investing."
rules.approvedValue: Legible standard risk disclosure displayed for minimum 5 seconds with synchronized audio narration
rules.sourceRef: SEBI Advertisement Code for Intermediaries (April 2023) Clause 4
rules.explanation: Enforces SEBI Advertisement Code 2023: Disclaimers must be legible, unhurried, and prominently displayed.

rules.title: Ban on Associations with Unregistered Financial Influencers and Tipsters
rules.ruleStatement: Regulated entities and fintech platforms must not engage or pay unregistered persons offering financial advice, stock recommendations, or performance promises.
rules.approvedValue: Partnerships restricted solely to SEBI-registered Investment Advisers (RIA) or Research Analysts (RA)
rules.sourceRef: SEBI Board Decision on Regulating Financial Influencers (June 2024)
rules.explanation: SEBI June 2024 Mandate: Strictly bars regulated entities from associating with unregistered financial social media creators.

updates.title: Circular on Disassociation of Regulated Entities with Unregistered Finfluencers
updates.summary: Directs all intermediaries to terminate promotional arrangements with financial influencers who dispense advice without valid SEBI registration within 90 days.
updates.recommendedAction: Audit affiliate marketing rosters and influencer contracts to confirm SEBI registration certificates.

regulatoryDepartments.name: ASCI
regulatoryDepartments.nodalMinistry: Self-Regulatory Body Recognized under Consumer Protection Framework & Cable TV Rules
regulatoryDepartments.shortDescription: Monitors the national advertising code, honest marketing, comparative supremacy claims, and social media influencer standards.
regulatoryDepartments.actName: ASCI Code for Self-Regulation in Advertising & Consumer Protection Recognition
regulatoryDepartments.statutoryRole: Recognized by the Supreme Court of India, CCPA, and Ministry of I&B under Rule 7(9) of the Cable Television Networks Rules as the benchmark advertising standard.

rules.title: Mandatory Prominent Influencer Material Connection Label (#Ad / #Sponsored)
rules.ruleStatement: Social media promotional content posted by creators must prominently display a disclosure label within the first 3 lines of copy or on video frames.
rules.approvedValue: Prominent, unambiguous disclosure badge (e.g. #Ad, #Sponsored, #Collaboration) placed upfront
rules.sourceRef: ASCI Guidelines for Influencer Advertising in Digital Media (2021) Clause 2
rules.explanation: Enforces ASCI Digital Influencer Guidelines: Commercial collaborations must be self-evident to viewers without expanding captions.

rules.title: Verifiable Substantiation for Comparative Supremacy Claims ("No. 1", "Fastest", "Best")
rules.ruleStatement: Superlative claims such as "India's No. 1", "Best in Class", or "Fastest Growing" must cite recent independent accredited market research.
rules.approvedValue: Published independent source citation with audit year (e.g., "Source: CRISIL Report Q4 2025")
rules.sourceRef: ASCI Code Chapter I: Truthful and Honest Representation §1.4
rules.sourceDocumentName: ASCI Code for Self-Regulation in Advertising
rules.explanation: Statutory ASCI Code standard: Unsubstantiated superlative claims mislead consumers and trigger expedited Consumer Complaints Council summons.

rules.title: Prohibition on Unsafe, Offensive, or Socially Irresponsible Depictions
rules.ruleStatement: Advertisements must not encourage hazardous practices, mock protected characteristics, or promote anti-social conduct.
rules.approvedValue: Responsible, socially positive depictions consistent with ASCI decency guidelines
rules.sourceRef: ASCI Code Chapter II: Non-Offensive to Public Decency §2.1
rules.sourceDocumentName: ASCI Code for Self-Regulation in Advertising
rules.explanation: Ensures advertising copy and visuals avoid unsafe behavior depictions or public decency violations.

updates.title: Half-Yearly Complaints Report: Surge in Deceptive Influencer Marketing
updates.summary: Reports a 38% increase in influencer compliance violations, predominantly in healthcare, personal care, and financial services.
updates.recommendedAction: Verify that all brand partner influencer posts include ASCI-compliant upfront disclosure tags.
